title: Official Holidays
text:
CR 27/2024, Art. 1 - Official Holidays
Public Holidays for the Public and Private Sector in the State, shall be as follows:
Holiday Date Number of Days
Gregorian New Year 1 January 1 day
Eid Al-Fitr From 01 to 03 Shawwal 3 days (*)
Arafa Day 09 Thu Al-Hijjah 1 day
Eid Al-Adha From 10 to 12 Thu Al-Hijjah 3 days
Hijri New Year 1 Muharram 1 day
Prophet’s Birthday 12 Rabi’ Al Awal 1 day
National Day From 2 to 3 December 2 days
(*) In the event the Month of Ramadan completes (30) days, day (30) of Ramadan shall be
deemed as an official holiday added to the Eid-Al-Fitr holiday.
Transfer of Official Holidays

CR 27/2024, Art. 2
With the exception of Eid Holidays, the Cabinet may – pursuant to a resolution it issues – transfer
any of the public holidays referred to in Article (1) of this Resolution to the beginning or end of
the week.

CR 27/2024, Art. 3
The Public Holiday cannot be transferred to another day in the event it coincides with another
public holiday or falls on the weekend.

title: Determination of Other Official Holidays
text:
CR 27/2024, Art. 4 - Determination of Other Official Holidays
Local governments may determine any other public holidays, not stipulated in this Resolution,
for its own government departments and corporations on any occasions related to it or for any
other reason.

title: Repeals
text:
CR 27/2024, Art. 5 - Repeals
Cabinet Resolution No. (27) of 2019, referred to above, shall be repealed as well as any provision
contradicting or conflicting with the provisions of this Resolution.

title: Publication and Enforcement
text:
CR 27/2024, Art. 6 - Publication and Enforcement
This Resolution shall be published in the Official Gazette and shall come into force as of 01
January 2025.
Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum
Prime Minister
Issued by us,
On: 22 / Ramadan / 1445 A.H
Corresponding: 01 / April / 2024 AD
